### Arcade debugger script used

```text
trace /tmp/arcade_boot_1s.trace,,noloop,{tracelog "PRE cyc=%d pc=%06X sr=%04X sp=%08X a5=%08X d0=%08X d1=%08X d2=%08X d3=%08X d4=%08X d5=%08X d6=%08X d7=%08X a0=%08X a1=%08X a2=%08X a3=%08X a4=%08X a6=%08X\n",totalcycles(),pc,sr,sp,a5,d0,d1,d2,d3,d4,d5,d6,d7,a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a6}

bp 3A008,,{tracelog "EVENT FIRST_VBLANK_ARCADE cyc=%d obs_pc=%06X sr=%04X sp=%08X a5=%08X\n",totalcycles(),pc,sr,sp,a5 ; g}

wp 100000,10000,w,,{tracelog "EVENT WRAM_WRITE_ARCADE cyc=%d obs_pc=%06X addr=%08X size_bits=%d old=%08X new=%08X\n",totalcycles(),pc,wpaddr,wpsize,wpdata,d@wpaddr ; g}

wp 380000,20100,r,,{tracelog "EVENT IO_READ_ARCADE cyc=%d obs_pc=%06X addr=%08X size_bits=%d value=%08X\n",totalcycles(),pc,wpaddr,wpsize,d@wpaddr ; g}

wp 380000,20100,w,,{tracelog "EVENT IO_WRITE_ARCADE cyc=%d obs_pc=%06X addr=%08X size_bits=%d old=%08X new=%08X\n",totalcycles(),pc,wpaddr,wpsize,wpdata,d@wpaddr ; g}

go
```
